arguments.sql:
SELECT c.colour, COUNT(*) AS heroes
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
GROUP BY c.colour

) AS blue_skin_percentage
FROM superhero AS s

LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
LIMIT 1
